actual_roundtrip.method: Every actual old/new forward capture was fed to its respective complete old/new dictionary via both real JA and ZH inverse functions. Expected text is the forward test's circumflex source with case folded, matching the inverse app contract. No output normalization. The only allowed word ambiguity is the actual dictionary compound rel/fork/o (轨叉o), now also assigned to frog/o. Two exact protected-kanji input fixtures also change plain interpretation after markers are removed; their exact before/after strings are recorded, not treated as exact source restoration. The current retained old key preserves former 辙叉 text. Every other mismatch/change remains a regression. One approved assignment in current only; shared owners and fixed legacy remain unchanged. Annotation glosses and source-side ruby text remain unchanged.

local_ui.method: Local Streamlit AppTest; upload/download transport observed, no browser or Cloud claim

actual_saved_html_recovery.method: Restore actual local AppTest downloads with the inverse application code

limitations: Only frog changes. The chosen high-place image of top=帆楼 and the separate -top-=境ᵀ combining form are preserved.
The existing dictionary entry rel/fork/o also renders 轨叉o. Its plain inverse becomes frogo; this accepted shared-spelling change is recorded separately from unexplained regressions.
Protected CJK in plain output has no percent-marker provenance and is interpreted by the chosen inverse dictionary; standard HTML retains the original text.
All-row and generated-form checks cover their finite inventories, not every natural sentence.
Local validation and Cloud browser verification are recorded separately.
